learning_goal: Recognise and name six colours; match by colour and symbol
piece_ids: RD1 RD2 RD3 RD4 RD5 RD6
correct_placements: RD1 -> red cloud | RD2 -> orange cloud | RD3 -> yellow cloud | RD4 -> green cloud | RD5 -> blue cloud | RD6 -> purple cloud
adult_guidance: Name each colour together. If colours are tricky, match the white symbols instead (heart, circle, star, leaf, wave, diamond).
works_with_finger_or_pencil: Yes - point to the matching cloud

learning_goal: Recognise circle, square, triangle, rectangle and star
correct_placements: SH3 -> triangle outline | SH1 -> circle outline | SH5 -> star outline | SH2 -> square outline | SH4 -> rectangle outline
adult_guidance: Trace each outline with a finger and count the corners together. A circle has no corners!

learning_goal: Follow a picture order; match colours; place items bottom-to-top
piece_ids: IC1 IC2 IC3 IC4 IC5 IC6
correct_placements: IC2 -> order 1 top scoop (chocolate) | IC1 -> order 1 bottom scoop (strawberry) | IC4 -> order 2 top scoop (lemon) | IC3 -> order 2 bottom scoop (mint) | IC6 -> order 3 top scoop (orange) | IC5 -> order 3 bottom scoop (blueberry)
adult_guidance: Read each order ticket from the bottom up. Afterwards, invite your child to invent their own ice cream.
works_with_finger_or_pencil: Partly - name the scoops on each ticket

learning_goal: Sort objects into groups by colour
correct_placements: flower 1 (red) -> red pot | flower 2 (blue) -> blue pot | flower 3 (yellow) -> yellow pot | flower 4 (blue) -> blue pot | flower 5 (red) -> red pot | flower 6 (yellow) -> yellow pot
adult_guidance: No cutting needed. Use a finger, a crayon or (if laminated) a dry-erase pen. Each pot shows a symbol as well as a colour.

learning_goal: Continue simple AB and AAB repeating patterns
correct_placements: pattern 1: red, blue, red, blue, red -> blue | pattern 2: yellow, green, yellow, green, yellow -> green | pattern 3: purple, purple, orange, purple, purple -> orange | pattern 4: red, red, yellow, red, red -> yellow | pattern 5: blue, orange, blue, orange, blue -> orange | pattern 6: green, green, purple, green, green -> purple
adult_guidance: Say the pattern aloud together ('red, blue, red, blue...'). Clapping or tapping the rhythm helps.

learning_goal: Build a whole picture from parts; top / middle / bottom vocabulary
correct_placements: RB1 -> robot antenna | RB2 -> robot head | RB3 -> robot body | RB4 -> robot wheels
adult_guidance: Once the robot is built, try a silly order on the table (wheels on top!) and talk about what changed.

learning_goal: Match animals to habitats; habitat vocabulary
piece_ids: AN1 AN2 AN3 AN4 AN5 AN6
correct_placements: AN1 -> ocean (fish) | AN4 -> icy land (penguin) | AN3 -> rainforest (monkey) | AN6 -> pond (frog) | AN5 -> desert (camel) | AN2 -> farm field (cow)
adult_guidance: Talk about each place: Is it wet or dry? Hot or cold? Many animals can live in more than one kind of place.

learning_goal: Match animals with a food they really eat
correct_placements: Panda -> bamboo | Bee -> flowers | Penguin -> fish | Squirrel -> acorns | Cow -> grass | Monkey -> banana
adult_guidance: No cutting needed. Each animal eats other foods too - this page shows one favourite. Pets should only eat food made for them.

learning_goal: Visual discrimination: match an outline to a picture
piece_ids: AN1 AN2 AN3 AN4 AN5 AN6
correct_placements: AN5 -> camel shadow | AN1 -> fish shadow | AN6 -> frog shadow | AN2 -> cow shadow | AN4 -> penguin shadow | AN3 -> monkey shadow
adult_guidance: Uses the same animal cards as Mission 07. Look at ears, tails and feet to tell the shadows apart.

learning_goal: Notice what is missing; animal body-part vocabulary
correct_placements: AP1 -> rabbit's missing ears | AP2 -> fox's missing tail | AP3 -> elephant's missing trunk
adult_guidance: Ask 'What is missing?' before showing the pieces. The dashed lines show where each part goes.

learning_goal: Match farm animals to where they like to be
correct_placements: FM1 -> hen house (hen) | FM2 -> mud puddle (pig) | FM3 -> pond (duck)
adult_guidance: Hens rest in the hen house, pigs cool off in mud and ducks love the pond. Make the animal sounds together!

learning_goal: Ocean-animal vocabulary; match shapes to outlines; story play
correct_placements: OC1 -> octopus (by the rocks) | OC2 -> turtle (swimming in the sea) | OC3 -> crab (on the sand)
adult_guidance: After placing the animals, make up a story: Where is the turtle swimming to?

learning_goal: Recognise numerals 1-10 and put them in order
piece_ids: NU1 NU2 NU3 NU4 NU5 NU6 NU7 NU8 NU9 NU10
correct_placements: NU1 -> train carriage 1 | NU2 -> train carriage 2 | NU3 -> train carriage 3 | NU4 -> train carriage 4 | NU5 -> train carriage 5 | NU6 -> train carriage 6 | NU7 -> train carriage 7 | NU8 -> train carriage 8 | NU9 -> train carriage 9 | NU10 -> train carriage 10
adult_guidance: Start with 1 to 5 for younger children. The small grey numbers can be covered with paper for an extra challenge.
works_with_finger_or_pencil: Yes - point and count along the train

learning_goal: Count up to 6 objects and match the quantity to a numeral
piece_ids: NU1 NU2 NU3 NU4 NU5 NU6
correct_placements: NU2 -> bunch 1 (2 balloons) | NU4 -> bunch 2 (4 balloons) | NU1 -> bunch 3 (1 balloons) | NU5 -> bunch 4 (5 balloons) | NU3 -> bunch 5 (3 balloons) | NU6 -> bunch 6 (6 balloons)
adult_guidance: Touch each balloon once while counting aloud. Uses number cards 1-6 (shared with Missions 13, 16, 18 and 36).

learning_goal: Count out a set of 2, 3 or 5 objects
correct_placements: TR1/TR2/TR3/TR4/TR5 -> plate (any cookie) | TR1/TR2/TR3/TR4/TR5 -> plate (any cookie) | TR1/TR2/TR3/TR4/TR5 -> plate (any cookie) | TR1/TR2/TR3/TR4/TR5 -> plate (any cookie) | TR1/TR2/TR3/TR4/TR5 -> plate (any cookie)
adult_guidance: Play one order at a time. Put the cookies on the plate, count them together, then 'feed' the monster and start again.
works_with_finger_or_pencil: Partly - count the cookies on the plate

learning_goal: Count 7 to 10 objects arranged in rows of five
correct_placements: NU7 -> tray 1 (7 cupcakes) | NU10 -> tray 2 (10 cupcakes) | NU8 -> tray 3 (8 cupcakes) | NU9 -> tray 4 (9 cupcakes)
adult_guidance: Each full row has 5 cupcakes. Count the full row, then keep counting: 'five... six, seven'. Uses number cards 7-10.

learning_goal: Compare two groups and say which has more
correct_placements: row 1 (apple: 3 vs 5) -> right | row 2 (star_item: 6 vs 2) -> left | row 3 (duck: 4 vs 1) -> left | row 4 (car: 2 vs 3) -> right
adult_guidance: No cutting needed. Count each side together, or line the pictures up with a finger to compare.

learning_goal: Order numerals from smallest to largest
piece_ids: NU1 NU2 NU3 NU4 NU5 NU6 NU7 NU8 NU9 NU10
correct_placements: NU1 -> tower 1, level 1 | NU2 -> tower 1, level 2 | NU3 -> tower 1, level 3 | NU4 -> tower 1, level 4 | NU5 -> tower 1, level 5 | NU6 -> tower 2, level 1 | NU7 -> tower 2, level 2 | NU8 -> tower 2, level 3 | NU9 -> tower 2, level 4 | NU10 -> tower 2, level 5
adult_guidance: Easier: build only the 1-5 tower (it shows helper dots). Challenge: build the 6-10 tower too.
works_with_finger_or_pencil: Yes - point from bottom to top

learning_goal: Connect clothing choices to sunny, rainy and cold weather
correct_placements: WE1 -> sunny weather (sun hat) | WE2 -> rainy weather (rain boots) | WE3 -> cold weather (warm scarf)
adult_guidance: Look out of the window together. Which piece would you choose today?
works_with_finger_or_pencil: Partly - point to the right clothes

learning_goal: Explore how faces can show feelings
correct_placements: FA1/FA2 -> eyes (any eye card) | FA3/FA4/FA5 -> mouth (any mouth card)
adult_guidance: There is no wrong answer. Try different eyes and mouths and ask 'How might Leo feel now? When do you feel like that?'
works_with_finger_or_pencil: Partly - draw features on a copy

learning_goal: Name common feelings
correct_placements: happy face -> happy | sad face -> sad | surprised face -> surprised | sleepy face -> sleepy | cross face -> cross | worried face -> worried
adult_guidance: No cutting needed. Read the words aloud. Faces can mean different things to different people - talk about other ideas too.

learning_goal: Sequence four everyday steps; first / next / last
correct_placements: RT1 -> step 1 (first) | RT2 -> step 2 (next) | RT3 -> step 3 (then) | RT4 -> step 4 (last)
adult_guidance: Every family's morning is different. The answer key shows one common order - any order your child can explain is fine.

learning_goal: Clothing vocabulary; head / body / feet
correct_placements: TD1 -> teddy's hat | TD2 -> teddy's jumper | TD3 -> teddy's boots
adult_guidance: Ask where each piece goes on our own bodies. Teddy can wear anything they like for pretend play too!

learning_goal: Think about kind and helpful actions
correct_placements: Oh no! The blocks fell down. -> Help tidy up | My friend feels sad. -> Ask 'Are you OK?' | My friend has no crayon. -> Share a crayon
adult_guidance: No cutting needed. Read each situation aloud. Ask: 'What else could we do to help?' - there are many kind answers.

learning_goal: Sort foods into three simple groups
piece_ids: SM1 SM2 SM3 SM4 SM5 SM6
correct_placements: SM1/SM2 -> fruit & veg shelf | SM1/SM2 -> fruit & veg shelf | SM3/SM4 -> bakery shelf | SM3/SM4 -> bakery shelf | SM5/SM6 -> dairy shelf | SM5/SM6 -> dairy shelf
adult_guidance: Fruit & veg, bakery and dairy are common supermarket groups. Play shop afterwards!

learning_goal: Decide which objects are useful for a day out
correct_placements: water bottle -> take it | bathtub -> leave it at home | lunchbox -> take it | book -> take it | sofa -> leave it at home | sun hat -> take it | piano -> leave it at home | jumper -> take it
adult_guidance: No cutting needed. The bathtub, sofa and piano are silly choices - enjoy the giggles!

learning_goal: Match household objects to rooms
correct_placements: HO2 -> bedroom (pillow) | HO3 -> kitchen (saucepan) | HO1 -> bathroom (toothbrush)
adult_guidance: Walk around your home and find these rooms together.

learning_goal: Follow a picture recipe in order (1, 2, 3)
correct_placements: CH3 -> sandwich step 4 (tomato) | CH2 -> sandwich step 3 (cheese) | CH1 -> sandwich step 2 (lettuce)
adult_guidance: Point to each step of the recipe card in order. Afterwards make a real snack together if you like.

learning_goal: Match vehicles to sky, road, railway and water
correct_placements: VE1 -> sky (plane) | VE2 -> road (car) | VE3 -> railway (train) | VE4 -> water (boat)
adult_guidance: Make the vehicle sounds together! Talk about which vehicles you have seen.

learning_goal: Morning, daytime and evening vocabulary
correct_placements: breakfast -> morning | playground -> daytime | bedtime story -> evening | lunch -> daytime | brushing teeth -> morning or evening
adult_guidance: No cutting needed. Every family's day is different - accept any answer your child can explain.

learning_goal: Match pictures to outlines on a simple map
correct_placements: TM1 -> palm tree | TM2 -> bridge (start) | TM3 -> lighthouse
adult_guidance: Follow the dotted path with a finger from the bridge to the treasure.

learning_goal: Complete a picture with shape pieces; triangle and arch shapes
correct_placements: CA1 -> left tower roof | CA2 -> right tower roof | CA4 -> flag on the wall | CA3 -> castle door
adult_guidance: Name the shapes together: triangle roofs, an arch door, a flag.

learning_goal: Simple visual sequences: first, next, last
correct_placements: row 1: seed, then sprout -> flower_grown | row 2: egg, then egg_crack -> chick | row 3: blocks_1, then blocks_2 -> blocks_3 | row 4: sunrise, then sun_high -> night
adult_guidance: No cutting needed. Tell each story aloud: 'First... then... next...'.

learning_goal: Sort natural objects: leaves, flowers and stones
correct_placements: leaf green -> leaves basket | stone round -> stones basket | daisy -> flowers basket | leaf oak -> leaves basket | tulip -> flowers basket | stone flat -> stones basket
adult_guidance: No cutting needed. On a walk, look at (but do not pick) leaves, flowers and stones together.

learning_goal: Visual memory and turn-taking
piece_ids: MP1 MP2 MP3 MP4 MP5 MP6 MP7 MP8
correct_placements: MP1/MP2/MP3/MP4/MP5/MP6/MP7/MP8 -> memory card spot (any card) | MP1/MP2/MP3/MP4/MP5/MP6/MP7/MP8 -> memory card spot (any card) | MP1/MP2/MP3/MP4/MP5/MP6/MP7/MP8 -> memory card spot (any card) | MP1/MP2/MP3/MP4/MP5/MP6/MP7/MP8 -> memory card spot (any card) | MP1/MP2/MP3/MP4/MP5/MP6/MP7/MP8 -> memory card spot (any card) | MP1/MP2/MP3/MP4/MP5/MP6/MP7/MP8 -> memory card spot (any card) | MP1/MP2/MP3/MP4/MP5/MP6/MP7/MP8 -> memory card spot (any card) | MP1/MP2/MP3/MP4/MP5/MP6/MP7/MP8 -> memory card spot (any card)
adult_guidance: Start with the cards face-up for younger children. Use only 2 or 3 pairs at first.

mission_name: GRAND FINALE: HELP LEO GET HOME
learning_goal: Combine colour, shape, counting and picture matching
correct_placements: RD5 -> Stop 1 · Colour (Find the BLUE drop) | SH5 -> Stop 2 · Shape (Find the STAR) | NU4 -> Stop 3 · Count (How many apples?) | AN4 -> Stop 4 · Picture (Who lives on the ice?)
adult_guidance: Uses cards from earlier missions: the blue drop (RD5), the star (SH5), number card 4 (NU4) and the penguin (AN4).
